verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents custom AI filters, written in plain English, that automatically label, star and archive mail, which makes the triage steerable. It also offers one-click identification of important emails and todos, Splits by importance, and triggers that organize threads into todos. Community evidence corroborates fast inbox clearing and grouping. Missing for 10: any evidence of auditing the AI's triage decisions (logs, history or explanations of why mail was labeled), in-depth docs on how importance classification works, and independent hands-on reports of the AI filters specifically.
